planning.label: Planning
planning.title: Strategic Planning
planning.description: We design comprehensive technical strategies for the development and growth of mining projects, from conceptual stages to operational consolidation. We integrate geological, metallurgical, and hydrogeological analyses, including geomechanical studies, to build clear roadmaps, reduce uncertainty, and support critical decisions with solid technical foundations and a long-term vision.

optimization.label: Optimization
optimization.title: Operations Optimization
optimization.description: We drive sustainable improvements in operational performance through process optimization, metallurgical recovery, and efficient resource use. We apply data-driven analysis, international benchmarking, and specialized diagnostics to increase productivity, reduce costs, and maximize the economic value of existing assets.

consulting.label: Consulting
consulting.title: Specialized Consulting
consulting.description: We provide independent technical advisory for investors, operators, and public entities that require expert and reliable judgment. Our multidisciplinary team brings experience in metallurgical processes, water management, and technical project evaluation, delivering rigorous analyses that support strategic decisions in complex environments.

hero.subtitle: Our Services
hero.description: Specialized solutions in underground planning, operational optimization, and value maximization for mining projects.

intro.textPart1: We develop mining strategies that transform technical complexity into tangible economic results. Our approach combines
intro.textPart2: with decades of operational experience to deliver plans that maximize the return on every project.

mineDesign.title: Underground and Open Pit Mine Design
mineDesign.shortDescription: Design engineering for underground and open-pit operations.
mineDesign.description: We develop economically and technically optimized mine designs, integrating geological, geomechanical, and hydrogeological modeling to define optimal extraction geometry. Our approach prioritizes maximizing mining asset value with the highest standards of safety and operational sustainability.
mineDesign.feature1: Open pit design, bench sequencing, and economic optimization
mineDesign.feature2: Underground mine design and exploitation method selection
mineDesign.feature3: Geomechanical modeling and access infrastructure, ramps, and galleries
mineDesign.feature4: Ventilation, drainage, ground support, and sustainability systems

costAnalysis.title: Cost Analysis
costAnalysis.shortDescription: Strategic evaluation of operating, process plant, and capital costs.
costAnalysis.description: We perform strategic analysis of cost structures in mine and process plant operations, identifying key cost drivers and operational gaps. We assess OPEX and CAPEX with a focus on improvement and optimization opportunities, benchmarking against comparable operations to maximize economic efficiency at each stage of the production process.
costAnalysis.feature1: Process plant cost analysis and unit costs by stage
costAnalysis.feature2: Cost driver identification and operational gap analysis
costAnalysis.feature4: Benchmarking with similar operations and improvement strategies

kpiImplementation.title: KPI Implementation
kpiImplementation.shortDescription: Comprehensive operational performance management in mine, plant, and water resources.
kpiImplementation.description: We design and implement key performance indicator systems for comprehensive mining operations management. Our team includes specialists in Metallurgy, Hydrogeology, Mine Planning, and Operations Management, enabling accurate technical and financial metrics in mine, process plant, and water resource management, and supporting data-driven decision-making for continuous improvement.
kpiImplementation.feature1: Operational and strategic KPIs in mining, metallurgy, and hydrogeology
kpiImplementation.feature2: Integrated management dashboards with technical and financial indicators
kpiImplementation.feature3: Measurement systems, automated reporting, and continuous improvement
kpiImplementation.feature4: Operations management focused on planning and performance

minePlanning.title: General Mine Planning
minePlanning.shortDescription: Strategic mining business planning with technical-financial integration.
minePlanning.description: We develop mine plans using an approved methodology that integrates technical vision with business financial objectives. From short-term planning to Life of Mine, we design and detail programs that optimize mining asset value while considering operational, market, and capital constraints, ensuring full technical-financial integration.
minePlanning.feature1: Strategic mining business planning with an approved methodology
minePlanning.feature2: Integrated short-, medium-, and long-term planning
minePlanning.feature3: Designed and detailed mine plan development
minePlanning.feature4: Mining asset value optimization and cut-off grade strategy

metallurgicalProcesses.title: Metallurgical Processes
metallurgicalProcesses.shortDescription: Recovery and cost optimization in process plants with measurable economic impact.
metallurgicalProcesses.description: We maximize recovery and reduce costs through rapid diagnostics, independent audits, and circuit optimization with measurable economic impact. We support strategic decisions (CAPEX/OPEX) and continuous improvement in gold, copper, and flotation operations.
metallurgicalProcesses.feature1: Rapid diagnostics and independent plant audits
metallurgicalProcesses.feature3: Strategic CAPEX/OPEX analysis in process plants
metallurgicalProcesses.feature4: Continuous improvement in gold, copper, and flotation operations

hydrogeologyWaterManagement.title: Applied Hydrogeology and Mine Water Management
hydrogeologyWaterManagement.shortDescription: Groundwater management with hydrogeological modeling and environmental compliance.
hydrogeologyWaterManagement.description: We manage groundwater in mining operations through aquifer characterization, pump tests, hydrogeological modeling and water balances. We reduce operational risks, optimize water resources and ensure environmental compliance with solutions tailored to each project.
hydrogeologyWaterManagement.feature4: Water quality assessment and environmental compliance

hero.subtitle: About Us
hero.description: Specialized consulting in underground mine planning with a focus on optimization, sustainability, and operational excellence.
hero.descriptionLine1: High-level technical consulting in mine planning, metallurgical processes, and hydrogeology.
hero.descriptionLine2: We drive operational optimization, sustainability, and technical excellence at every stage of the mining cycle.

methodology.description: Our proven methodology ensures that every project receives the attention and detailed analysis needed to achieve its objectives.
methodology.step1Desc: We deeply understand the geological context, deposit characteristics, and specific operating conditions of each project.
methodology.step2Desc: We evaluate and select the most suitable mining method, considering technical, economic, and safety factors to maximize project value.
methodology.step3Desc: We develop detailed mine plans and support implementation with a focus on operational efficiency, cost reduction, and continuous improvement.
methodology.step4Desc: We maximize recovery and reduce costs through rapid diagnostics, independent audits, and circuit optimization with measurable economic impact. We support strategic CAPEX/OPEX decisions and continuous improvement in gold, copper, and flotation operations.

methodology.step5Desc: We manage groundwater in mining operations through aquifer characterization, pump tests, hydrogeological modeling and water balances. We reduce operational risks, optimize water resources and ensure environmental compliance with solutions tailored to each project.

sustainability.description: We believe in the balance between operational efficiency and environmental stewardship. Our solutions integrate sustainable practices that ensure the long-term viability of every mining operation.
sustainability.feature1Desc: We balance prices and costs with flexible and efficient operational responses.
sustainability.feature2Desc: We optimize natural resource usage while minimizing environmental impact.
sustainability.feature3Desc: We design plans that ensure future economic and environmental viability.

expertise.description: We offer comprehensive solutions covering the entire lifecycle of mining operations, from planning to optimization.
expertise.area1Desc: We develop efficient mine designs and programs that maximize value extraction while optimizing operating costs.
expertise.area2Desc: Expertise in transitioning open-pit operations to underground mining, optimizing sequence and minimizing risks.
expertise.area3Desc: We implement mechanization and automation solutions that increase productivity and operational safety.
expertise.area4Title: Concentrator Plant Processes and Applied Metallurgy
expertise.area4Desc: We optimize metallurgical processes to maximize value per processed ton. We apply rapid diagnostics and technical analysis to identify gaps, improve recoveries, and reduce costs through actionable solutions with measurable financial impact.
expertise.area5Title: Applied Hydrogeology and Mine Water Management
expertise.area5Desc: We develop applied hydrogeology solutions for mining, infrastructure, and energy projects. We integrate studies, modeling, and dewatering systems to manage water risks, optimize water resources, and support operational decisions with strong technical foundations and regulatory compliance.
